definitions.short: Mikajah , the name of an Israelite and an Israelitess
definitions.full: H4322. Mikayahu מִיכָיָ֫הוּ proper name ( Who is like Yah? compare מִיכָאֵל ): — 1. masculine a prince under Jehosh. 2Chr 17:7 . 2. feminine 2Chr 13:2 f. l. for מִעֲכָה 2b , q. v.. Of this name, the following are abbreviated, or softened, forms —

occurrences.englishText: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
